header.title: Assessment Settings
header.subtitle: Configure assessment features for your institute

offlineEntry.title: Offline Data Entry
offlineEntry.description: Allow data entry users to manually input student responses from paper-based tests. This enables analytics for both online and offline exams.
offlineEntry.enableHint: Shows the "Offline Entry" button on the assessment submissions page

reportBranding.title: Assessment Report Branding
reportBranding.description: Customize the look and feel of PDF reports generated for students. These settings apply to all assessment reports across your institute.
